definition: שַׁ֫עַר 373 noun masculine 2Sam 18:24 ( feminine Isa 14:31 in personification, Albr ZAW xvi (1896), 86 ) gate ; — ׳ שׁ absolute Judg 9:40 +, construct Gen 22:17 +; with ה locative, שָׁ֑עְרָה Isa 28:6 +; plural שְׁעָרִים 2Sam 18:24 +, construct שַׁעֲרֵי 1Sam 17:52 +; suffix שְׁעָרֶיךָ Deut 12:15 +, שַׁעֲרֵיהֶם Ezek 21:20 ; Ezek 48:34 , etc.; — 1. a. gate , entrance to city, shut ( סָגַר ) by night Josh 2:5 ; Josh 2:7 ( J E ), compare Isa 45:1 , opened ( פָּתַח ) by day Neh 7:3 , compare Isa 60:11 for entrance ( בּוֺא ), and exit ( יָצָא ) Jer 17:19 ; Jer 17:20 ; Jer 17:21 ; Jer 17:24 ; Jer 17:25 ; Jer 17:27 ; Lam 4:12 ; Ezek 26:10 +; ׳ עָבַר שׁ Mic 2:13 pass out through (disregard accents), ׳ בַּשׁ ׳ ע Isa 62:10 with bars Ps 147:13 attacked Ezek 21:20 ; Ezek 21:27 , compare Isa 28:6 ; Mic 1:9 ; Mic 1:12 ; 1Sam 17:52 on Judg 5:8 ; Judg 5:11 see Commentaries; burned (by foe) Jer 19:27 ; Jer 51:58 ; Neh 1:3 ; Neh 2:3 ; Neh 2:13 ; Neh 2:17 as giving control, possession, of city, אֹיְבָיו ׳ יָרַשׁ אֵת שׁ Gen 22:17 ; Gen 24:60 ( J ); ׳ פֶּתַח הַשּׁ Judg 9:40 + (see ׳ פ ), ׳ דַּלְתוֺת הַשּׁ 1Sam 21:14 + (see ׳ ד 3 ); ׳ פֶּתַחהַֿשּׁ Judg 18:16 ; Judg 18:17 of farm or village; so of camp Exod 32:26 ; Exod 32:27 ( J ). In cities, elaborate structure, with roof 2Sam 18:24 , upper chamber 2Sam 19:1 compare שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם Ps 24:7 ; Ps 24:9 write laws ׳ בִּשׁ Deut 6:9 ( + עַלמְֿזֻזוֺת בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ ), Deut 11:20 (+ id. .); ׳ בְּתוֺךְ הַשּׁ 1Sam 9:18 , ׳ אֶלאתּוֺךְ הַשּׁ 2Sam 3:27 ׳ (לְ)יַד שׁ as public, 1Sam 4:18 , + v 1Sam 4:13 ᵐ5 Th We Dr and others, compare 2Sam 15:2 ; 2Sam 18:4 ; Prov 8:3 (|| מְבוֺא פְתָחִים ). \ \ b. particular gates of Jerusalem are: (1) אֶפְרַיִם ׳ שׁ 2Kgs 14:13 || 2Chr 25:23 ; Neh 8:16 ; Neh 12:39 (2) הָאַשְׁפֹּת ׳ שׁ Neh 2:13 ; Neh 3:14 ; Neh 12:31 = הָֽשְׁפוֺת ׳ שׁ Neh 3:13 (3) בִּנְיָמִין ׳ שׁ Jer 37:13 ; Jer 38:7 ; Zech 14:10 (4) הַגַּיִא ׳ שׁ Neh 2:13 ; Neh 2:15 ; Neh 3:13 ; 2Chr 26:9 (5) הַדָּגִים ׳ שׁ Zeph 1:10 ; Neh 3:3 ; Neh 12:39 ; 2Chr 33:14 (6) בֵּין הַחֹמֹתַיִם ׳ שׁ 2Kgs 25:4 = Jer 52:7 compare Jer 39:4 (7) החרסות ׳ שׁ Jer 19:2 (8) הַיְשָׁנָה ׳ שׁ Neh 3:6 ; Neh 12:39 (9) הַמִּזְרָךְ ׳ שׁ Neh 3:29 (10) הַמַּטָּרָה ׳ שׁ Neh 12:39 (11) ׳ הַמָּ֑יִם שׁ Neh 8:1 ; Neh 8:3 ; Neh 8:16 (12) הַמַּיִם לַמִּזְרָ֑ח ׳ שׁ Neh 3:26 ,compare Neh 12:37 (13) הַמִּפְקָ֑ד ׳ שׁ Neh 3:31 (14) הָעַיִן ׳ שׁ Neh 2:14 ; Neh 3:15 ; Neh 12:37 (15) הַסּוּסִים ׳ שׁ Jer 31:40 ; Neh 3:28 (compare 3 b ); (16) הַפִּנָּה ׳ שׁ 2Kgs 14:13 || 2Chr 25:23 (read הַפִּנָּה for הַפּוֺנֶה ), Jer 31:38 ; 2Chr 26:9 probably = הַפִּנִּים ׳ שׁ Zech 14:10 (17) הַצּאֹן ׳ שׁ Neh 3:1 ; Neh 3:32 ; Neh 12:39 (18) הָרִאשׁוֺן ׳ שׁ Zech 14:10 — on sites and related to each other see RS- GASm Ency. Ezek 48 . 2. a. gate = space inside gate, as public meeting-place, market 2Kgs 7:1 ; 2Kgs 7:18 , place of public well 2Sam 23:15 ; 2Sam 23:16 = 1Chr 11:17 ; 1Chr 11:18 , where elders, judges, king, sat officially Deut 21:19 ; Deut 22:15 ; Amos 5:12 ; Amos 5:15 ; Isa 29:21 ; 2Sam 18:24 ; 2Sam 19:9 ; 1Kgs 22:10 = 2Chr 18:9 ; Gen 19:1 ( J ) Prov 24:7 ; Job 5:4 ; Job 31:21 ; Ruth 4:1 (twice in verse); Prov 31:23 ; Prov 31:31 , etc.; of conqueror Jer 1:15 apparently = ׳ רְחוֺב שׁ Gen 19:2 ( J ) Neh 8:16 ; 1Chr 9:16 + (see I. ׳ ר ); Gen 34:20 ( P ) one came unto gate ( בָּא אֶלֿ ), so ׳ בָּאֵי שׁ Gen 23:10 ; Gen 23:18 ( P ) those entering the gate , i.e. having citizens' rights; also went out (to), ׳ יָצָא שׁ Job 29:7 (i.e., in this case, from his own house, outside the city), hence ׳ כָּליֹֿצְאֵי שׁ Gen 34:24 (twice in verse) ( P ; compare also הוֺצִיא אֶלֿ Deut 21:19 ; Deut 22:15 ; Deut 22:24 ); hence = body of citizens, עַמִּי ׳ כָּלשֿׁ Ruth 3:11 . \ \ b. hence also = city Isa 14:31 (|| עִיר ), Ps 87:2 , etc. \ \ c. specifically in Deuteronomy, בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ in thy gates , i.e. thy cities, towns, etc., Deut 5:14 = Exod 20:10 ; Deut 12:12 ; Deut 12:15 ; Deut 12:17 ; Deut 12:21 + 22 t. Deuteronomy + 1Kgs 8:37 (read ׳ בְּאַחַד שׁ , compare Deut 18:6 ; Deut 23:17 , so ᵐ5 ᵑ6 modern), so || 2Chr 6:28 , + (perhaps) Jer 14:2 (but Jer 15:7 ; Nah 3:13 figurative of gates as entrance to land); of private house, שַׁעֲרֵי צַדִּיק Prov 14:19 (perhaps compare Judg 18:16 1 a above). 3. a. gate of royal castle or palace 2Kgs 9:31 ; Jer 22:2 ; Jer 22:4 ; Neh 2:8 ; Esth 2:19 + 10 t. Esther; specifically (of king of Judah), סוּר ׳ שׁ 2Kgs 11:6 = הַיְסוֺד ׳ שׁ 2Chr 23:5 (see ׳ ס , ׳ יס ), הָרָצִים ׳ שׁ 2Kgs 11:19 , ׳ אַחַר הָר ׳ הַשּׁ v 2Kgs 11:6 ׳ הַסּוּסִים בֵּית הַמּ ׳ שׁ 2Chr 23:15 ( = ׳ מְבוֺא הַסּ || 2Kgs 11:16 ); apparently of official residence, יְהוֺשֻׁעַ ׳ פֶּתַח שׁ 2Kgs 23:8 . \ \ b. of temple Jer 7:2 (twice in verse); 1Chr 9:23 ; 1Chr 16:42 + 12 t. Chronicles, including ׳ שַׁעֲרֵי מַחֲנוֺת י 2Chr 31:2 (see מַחֲנֶה 1 , p. 334), compare Ps 100:4 ; Ps 118:20 , שַׁעֲרֵי צֶדֶק v Ps 100:19 specifically בִּנְיָמִין הָעֶלְיוֺן ׳ שׁ Jer 20:2 , and (omit ׳ בִּנְי ) 2Kgs 15:35 = 2Chr 27:3 ; Ezek 9:2 ; 2Chr 23:20 , הֶחָדָשׁ ׳ (בֵּית) י ׳ שׁ Jer 26:10 ; Jer 36:10 , הַפְּנִימִית הַפּוֺנֶה ׳ שׁ צָפוֺנָה Ezek 8:3 compare v Ezek 8:14 , Ezek 8:5 , הַקַּדְמֹנִי ׳ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ שַׁעַר בֵּית י ׳ שׁ Ezek 10:19 ; Ezek 11:1 שַׁלֶּכֶת ׳ שׁ 1Chr 26:16 שַׁעַר הַמֶּלֶח 1Chr 9:18 . \ \ c. of Ezekiel's temple and courts Ezek 40:3 ; Ezek 40:6 ; Ezek 44:11 ; Ezek 44:17 + 67 t. Ezek 40-47. \ \ d. of court of tabernacle ( P ), הֶחָצֵר ׳ שׁ Exod 27:16 ; Exod 35:17 + 6t. Exodus + Num 4:36 . 4. figurative הַשָּׁמַיִם ׳ זֶה שׁ Gen 28:17 ( E ; || בֵּית אֱלֹהִים ); plural שַׁעֲרֵי שְׁאוֺל Isa 38:10 מָֿוֶת ׳ שׁ Job 38:17 ; Ps 9:14 ; Ps 107:18 צַלְמָוֶת ׳ שׁ Job 38:17 .

שַׁ֫עַר373 noun masculine2Sam 18:24 (feminineIsa 14:31 in personification, AlbrZAW xvi (1896), 86) gate; — ׳שׁ absolute Judg 9:40 +, construct Gen 22:17 +; with ה locative, שָׁ֑עְרָה Isa 28:6 +; plural שְׁעָרִים 2Sam 18:24 +, construct שַׁעֲרֵי 1Sam 17:52 +; suffix שְׁעָרֶיךָ Deut 12:15 +, שַׁעֲרֵיהֶם Ezek 21:20; Ezek 48:34, etc.; —

1. a. gate, entrance to city, shut (סָגַר) by night Josh 2:5; Josh 2:7 (JE), compare Isa 45:1, opened (פָּתַח) by day Neh 7:3, compare Isa 60:11 for entrance (בּוֺא), and exit (יָצָא) Jer 17:19; Jer 17:20; Jer 17:21; Jer 17:24; Jer 17:25; Jer 17:27; Lam 4:12; Ezek 26:10 +; ׳עָבַר שׁ Mic 2:13 pass out through (disregard accents), ׳בַּשׁ ׳ע Isa 62:10 with bars Ps 147:13 attacked Ezek 21:20; Ezek 21:27, compare Isa 28:6; Mic 1:9; Mic 1:12; 1Sam 17:52 on Judg 5:8; Judg 5:11 see Commentaries; burned (by foe) Jer 19:27; Jer 51:58; Neh 1:3; Neh 2:3; Neh 2:13; Neh 2:17 as giving control, possession, of city, אֹיְבָיו ׳יָרַשׁ אֵת שׁ Gen 22:17; Gen 24:60 (J); ׳פֶּתַח הַשּׁ Judg 9:40 + (see ׳פ), ׳דַּלְתוֺת הַשּׁ 1Sam 21:14 + (see ׳ד 3); ׳פֶּתַחהַֿשּׁ Judg 18:16; Judg 18:17 of farm or village; so of camp Exod 32:26; Exod 32:27 (J). In cities, elaborate structure, with roof 2Sam 18:24, upper chamber 2Sam 19:1 compare שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם Ps 24:7; Ps 24:9 write laws ׳בִּשׁ Deut 6:9 ( + עַלמְֿזֻזוֺת בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ), Deut 11:20 (+id..); ׳בְּתוֺךְ הַשּׁ 1Sam 9:18, ׳אֶלאתּוֺךְ הַשּׁ 2Sam 3:27 ׳(לְ)יַד שׁ as public, 1Sam 4:18, + v1Sam 4:13 ᵐ5 Th We Dr and others, compare 2Sam 15:2; 2Sam 18:4; Prov 8:3 (|| מְבוֺא פְתָחִים).
\ \ b. particular gates of Jerusalem are: (1) אֶפְרַיִם ׳שׁ 2Kgs 14:13 || 2Chr 25:23; Neh 8:16; Neh 12:39 (2) הָאַשְׁפֹּת ׳שׁ Neh 2:13; Neh 3:14; Neh 12:31 = הָֽשְׁפוֺת ׳שׁ Neh 3:13 (3) בִּנְיָמִין ׳שׁ Jer 37:13; Jer 38:7; Zech 14:10 (4) הַגַּיִא ׳שׁ Neh 2:13; Neh 2:15; Neh 3:13; 2Chr 26:9 (5) הַדָּגִים ׳שׁ Zeph 1:10; Neh 3:3; Neh 12:39; 2Chr 33:14 (6) בֵּין הַחֹמֹתַיִם ׳שׁ 2Kgs 25:4 = Jer 52:7 compare Jer 39:4 (7) החרסות ׳שׁ Jer 19:2 (8) הַיְשָׁנָה ׳שׁ Neh 3:6; Neh 12:39 (9) הַמִּזְרָךְ ׳שׁ Neh 3:29 (10) הַמַּטָּרָה ׳שׁ Neh 12:39 (11) ׳הַמָּ֑יִם שׁ Neh 8:1; Neh 8:3; Neh 8:16 (12) הַמַּיִם לַמִּזְרָ֑ח ׳שׁ Neh 3:26,compare Neh 12:37 (13) הַמִּפְקָ֑ד ׳שׁ Neh 3:31 (14) הָעַיִן ׳שׁ Neh 2:14; Neh 3:15; Neh 12:37 (15) הַסּוּסִים ׳שׁ Jer 31:40; Neh 3:28 (compare 3 b); (16) הַפִּנָּה ׳שׁ 2Kgs 14:13 || 2Chr 25:23 (read הַפִּנָּה for הַפּוֺנֶה), Jer 31:38; 2Chr 26:9 probably = הַפִּנִּים ׳שׁ Zech 14:10 (17) הַצּאֹן ׳שׁ Neh 3:1; Neh 3:32; Neh 12:39 (18) הָרִאשׁוֺן ׳שׁ Zech 14:10 — on sites and related to each other see RS-GASmEncy. \ \ c. of Ezekiel's holy city, שַׁעֲרֵי הָעִיר Ezek 48:31, three on each side, named for tribes, vEzek 48:31 vEzek 48:31 vEzek 48:31 vEzek 48:31 + 12 t. Ezek 48.
2. a. gate = space inside gate, as public meeting-place, market 2Kgs 7:1; 2Kgs 7:18, place of public well 2Sam 23:15; 2Sam 23:16 = 1Chr 11:17; 1Chr 11:18, where elders, judges, king, sat officially Deut 21:19; Deut 22:15; Amos 5:12; Amos 5:15; Isa 29:21; 2Sam 18:24; 2Sam 19:9; 1Kgs 22:10 = 2Chr 18:9; Gen 19:1 (J) Prov 24:7; Job 5:4; Job 31:21; Ruth 4:1 (twice in verse); Prov 31:23; Prov 31:31, etc.; of conqueror Jer 1:15 apparently = ׳רְחוֺב שׁ Gen 19:2 (J) Neh 8:16; 1Chr 9:16 + (see I. ׳ר); Gen 34:20 (P) one came unto gate (בָּא אֶלֿ), so ׳בָּאֵי שׁ Gen 23:10; Gen 23:18 (P) those entering the gate, i.e. having citizens' rights; also went out (to), ׳יָצָא שׁ Job 29:7 (i.e., in this case, from his own house, outside the city), hence ׳כָּליֹֿצְאֵי שׁ Gen 34:24 (twice in verse) (P; compare also הוֺצִיא אֶלֿ Deut 21:19; Deut 22:15; Deut 22:24); hence = body of citizens, עַמִּי׳כָּלשֿׁ Ruth 3:11.
\ \ b. hence also = city Isa 14:31 (|| עִיר), Ps 87:2, etc.
\ \ c. specifically in Deuteronomy, בִּשְׁעָרֶיךָ in thy gates, i.e. thy cities, towns, etc., Deut 5:14 = Exod 20:10; Deut 12:12; Deut 12:15; Deut 12:17; Deut 12:21 + 22 t. Deuteronomy + 1Kgs 8:37 (read ׳בְּאַחַד שׁ, compare Deut 18:6; Deut 23:17, so ᵐ5 ᵑ6 modern), so || 2Chr 6:28, + (perhaps) Jer 14:2 (but Jer 15:7; Nah 3:13 figurative of gates as entrance to land); of private house, שַׁעֲרֵי צַדִּיק Prov 14:19 (perhaps compare Judg 18:16 1 a above).
3. a. gate of royal castle or palace 2Kgs 9:31; Jer 22:2; Jer 22:4; Neh 2:8; Esth 2:19 + 10 t. Esther; specifically (of king of Judah), סוּר ׳שׁ 2Kgs 11:6 = הַיְסוֺד ׳שׁ 2Chr 23:5 (see ׳ס, ׳יס), הָרָצִים ׳שׁ 2Kgs 11:19, ׳אַחַר הָר ׳הַשּׁ v2Kgs 11:6 ׳הַסּוּסִים בֵּית הַמּ ׳שׁ 2Chr 23:15 ( = ׳מְבוֺא הַסּ || 2Kgs 11:16); apparently of official residence, יְהוֺשֻׁעַ ׳פֶּתַח שׁ 2Kgs 23:8.
\ \ b. of temple Jer 7:2 (twice in verse); 1Chr 9:23; 1Chr 16:42 + 12 t. Chronicles, including ׳שַׁעֲרֵי מַחֲנוֺת י 2Chr 31:2 (see מַחֲנֶה 1, p. 334), compare Ps 100:4; Ps 118:20, שַׁעֲרֵי צֶדֶק vPs 100:19 specifically בִּנְיָמִין הָעֶלְיוֺן ׳שׁ Jer 20:2, and (omit ׳בִּנְי) 2Kgs 15:35 = 2Chr 27:3; Ezek 9:2; 2Chr 23:20, הֶחָדָשׁ ׳(בֵּית) י ׳שׁ Jer 26:10; Jer 36:10, הַפְּנִימִית הַפּוֺנֶה ׳שׁ צָפוֺנָה Ezek 8:3 compare vEzek 8:14, Ezek 8:5, הַקַּדְמֹנִי ׳הַמִּזְבֵּחַ שַׁעַר בֵּית י ׳שׁ Ezek 10:19; Ezek 11:1 שַׁלֶּכֶת ׳שׁ 1Chr 26:16 שַׁעַר הַמֶּלֶח 1Chr 9:18.
\ \ c. of Ezekiel's temple and courts Ezek 40:3; Ezek 40:6; Ezek 44:11; Ezek 44:17 + 67 t. Ezek 40-47.
\ \ d. of court of tabernacle (P), הֶחָצֵר ׳שׁ Exod 27:16; Exod 35:17 + 6t. Exodus + Num 4:36.
4. figurative הַשָּׁמַיִם ׳זֶה שׁ Gen 28:17 (E; || בֵּית אֱלֹהִים); plural שַׁעֲרֵי שְׁאוֺל Isa 38:10 מָֿוֶת׳שׁ Job 38:17; Ps 9:14; Ps 107:18 צַלְמָוֶת ׳שׁ Job 38:17.
